```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidypopgen)
library(tidyr)
library(Matrix)
library(ggalign)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(viridis)
library(pheatmap)
```


```{r set-directories}
res_dir <- "../results/s08_FST/"
```

# Load and group gt

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld_imputed.gt")
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
```

# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```

# Impute

```{r}
gt_set_imputed(mad_bor_g1000_sum, TRUE)
```

# Replace names

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  mutate(population = case_when(
    population == "Sakalava_Tsimihety" ~ "Sakalava/Tsimihety",
    population == "Diego" ~ "Diego Mixed",
    TRUE ~ population
  ))
```

# Pairwise Fst

```{r}
fst_matrix <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  pairwise_pop_fst(by_locus = FALSE, method = "WC84", type = "pairwise")
```


```{r}
# subset fst matrix
sub <- c(
  "Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego Mixed", "Sakalava/Tsimihety",
  "Betsileo", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro", "Mozambique_Chopi", "Borneo"
)

fst_matrix <- as.data.frame(fst_matrix)
fst_matrix_sub <- as.data.frame(fst_matrix)
rm <- names(fst_matrix_sub)[(names(fst_matrix_sub) %in% sub)]
fst_matrix_sub <- fst_matrix_sub[, rm]

fst_matrix_sub <-
  subset(
    fst_matrix_sub,
    rownames(fst_matrix_sub) %in% c(
      "Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego Mixed",
      "Sakalava/Tsimihety", "Betsileo",
      "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro",
      "Mozambique_Chopi", "Borneo"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
ggheatmap(fst_matrix_sub) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(expression("F"[st])) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -60, hjust = 0))
```

```{r}
sub <- c(
  "Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego Mixed", "Sakalava/Tsimihety",
  "Betsileo", "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro"
)

fst_matrix_sub <- as.data.frame(fst_matrix)
rm <- names(fst_matrix_sub)[(names(fst_matrix_sub) %in% sub)]
fst_matrix_sub <- fst_matrix_sub[, rm]


fst_matrix_sub <-
  subset(

fst_merina_together <- ggheatmap(fst_matrix_sub) +
```

```{r}
print(fst_matrix_sub)
```

# Population level FST for Merina subsets

```{r}
# Load fastmixture Q matrix
qmats <- readRDS("../data/intermediate/fastmixture/fastmixture_m.RData")
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld.gt")
```

```{r}
# tidy with the gt
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- augment(get_q_matrix(qmats, k = 3, run = 1),
  data = mad_bor_g1000_sum
)
# filter to merina
merina <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(population == "Merina")
# split groups
merina$population <- ifelse(merina$.Q3 > 0.5, "Merina A", "Merina B")
merina <- merina[, c("id", "population")]

# match V2 and merina$id and replace the population column in
# merina_fam with the population column in merina
matching_m <- match(mad_bor_g1000_sum$id, merina$id)
mad_bor_g1000_sum$population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m),
  merina$population[matching_m],
  mad_bor_g1000_sum$population
)
```

# Pairwise Fst

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  filter(population %in% c(
    "Betsimisaraka", "Merina A", "Merina B", "Diego Mixed",
    "Sakalava/Tsimihety", "Betsileo", "Vezo",
    "Mikea", "Temoro"
  ))

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% group_by(population)
```

```{r}
fst_matrix <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  pairwise_pop_fst(by_locus = FALSE, method = "WC84", type = "pairwise")
```

# Pairwise Fst heatmap with dendrogram and Merina split

```{r}
# https://bioinformatics.ccr.cancer.gov/docs/data-visualization-with-r/Lesson5_intro_to_ggplot/
pheatmap(fst_matrix,
  color = viridis(256),
  angle_col = 45,
  filename = paste0(res_dir, "fst_dendrogram_merina_split_.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```

# Other heatmap versions

```{r}
heatmap(fst_matrix, col = viridis(256)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -60, hjust = 0))

ggheatmap(fst_matrix) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = expression("F"[st])) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -60, hjust = 0))


#https://stackoverflow.com/questions/38727324/adding-a-dendrogram-to-a-ggplot2-heatmap 
#https://yunuuuu.github.io/ggalign-book/complexheatmap-single-heatmap.html

ggheatmap(fst_matrix) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = expression("F"[st])) +
  anno_right(size = unit(15, "mm")) +
  align_dendro(reorder_dendrogram = TRUE) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank()) +

  anno_top(size = unit(15, "mm")) +
  align_dendro(reorder_dendrogram = TRUE) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +

  quad_active() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -60, hjust = 0)
  )
```

# Merina split with no dendrogram

```{r}
fst_merina_split <- ggheatmap(fst_matrix) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = expression("F"[st])) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -60, hjust = 0))
fst_merina_split


ggsave(paste0(res_dir, "fst_merina_split.jpg"),
  width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```

## Recording R environment

Part of ensuring our workflow is reproducible is to keep track of the R environment.
We will automatically save our R environment into a file called `r_environment.json`.

```{r save-r-environment, echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename_rmd <- "s08_FST.Rmd"
filename_renv <- paste0(
  res_dir, "/renv_",
  tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filename_rmd)),
  ".json"
)
renv::lockfile_write(renv::lockfile_create(), file = filename_renv)

```
